entry.title: New: RES24-201 (Honolulu) — CCL
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT OF TWO TWILIGHT TOUR CERTIFICATES FOR UP TO FIVE GUESTS PER CERTIFICATE, VALUED AT $200 TO THE CITY FROM THE HONOLULU ZOOLOGICAL SOCIETY FOR THE OFFICE OF THE MANAGING DIRECTOR TO PRESENT TO THE WINNERS OF THE EMPLOYEE FOOD DRIVE FOR THE HAWAIʻI FOODBANK.
